DPES-753 slice 753.B .meta fixtures: provenance

Source
  Each file is a real state record taken from the private firstmate home (the
  firstmate-pstack checkout), then redacted as described under Redaction. They are not
  byte-for-byte copies of the source. No file here is generated by Rust or by hand, apart
  from that redaction. Paths below are relative to that home's root. The source paths are
  snapshots: live records keep being rewritten, so a source may no longer match its hash.
  The fixture bytes are the copy that counts.

Files
  dpes-753-a-config-home-followups.meta

    shape:   endpoint_task_id, worktree, harness, kind, base_branch; no backend (tmux default)

    source:  data/dpes-845-birds-eye-model/ac01-home/state/DPES-901.meta

    shape:   smallest record; worktree, harness, kind; no endpoint_task_id or base_branch

Selection
  Four records cover three key sets and an absent backend. Records with a
  repeated key were not found in the survey, so no repeated-key sample is saved here.
  The shell's hold script does write repeated keys (decision_keys), so repeated-key
  reads are pinned by inline text in tests/state_meta.rs.

Checks
  Every line is key=value: no blank lines, no carriage returns, and no repeated key.

Redaction
  The operator's username was removed from absolute local paths. Each /Users/<operator>/
  prefix in the worktree, project, and managed_worktree values became /Users/REDACTED/.
  Nothing else changed: keys, line order, and line count match the source, and the parsing
  assertions in tests/state_meta.rs hold on the redacted bytes. The /tmp task paths carry no
  username and are kept as they were. The sha256 values above are of the redacted bytes.
  Why: the repository is internal, but a personal username does not belong in committed
  fixtures, and the redacted copies keep every key and value shape the reader parses.
  A search for token, secret, and password found no matches.
